query:
-- Vérifier la molécule 810043
SELECT id, name FROM molecules WHERE id = 810043;

-- Toutes les liaisons dominantes de Rose de Damas (ghost_variety_id = 1)
SELECT gvml.molecule_id, gvml.link_type, gvml.percentage, m.name 
FROM ghost_variety_molecule_links gvml 
LEFT JOIN molecules m ON gvml.molecule_id = m.id 
WHERE gvml.ghost_variety_id = 1 AND gvml.link_type = 'dominant'
ORDER BY CAST(gvml.percentage AS DECIMAL) DESC;
